# Quinn

> Quinn is the AI studio for fashion brands. It turns flat garment photography — flatlays and ghost-mannequin shots — into photoreal on-model imagery and social-ready catalog videos, without a studio, models, or shoot logistics.

Quinn is operated by Quinn Care Private Limited (India). It helps DTC, fashion, and lifestyle brands produce e-commerce and marketing visuals from the product shots they already have, replacing weeks of sample shipping, model casting, and shoot logistics with a desk workflow. Quinn also builds a Shopify app, Quinn Shoppable Videos & Reels, that turns product videos and social reels into shoppable, tappable widgets on a store.

## What Quinn does

- **On-model shots**: Upload a flatlay or ghost-mannequin image and Quinn generates photoreal on-model photography with control over model, pose, body type, skin tone, and backdrop — kept consistent across a catalog and ready for product detail pages (PDP) and ads.
- **Catalog video**: Turn an existing catalog shoot — or just a flatlay — into motion: model walks, 360° product spins, and dynamic reels. Exported for Reels/TikTok (9:16), feed (1:1), and hero (16:9) placements.
- **Clone** (https://clone.quinn.live/): Copies a short-form fashion video that already went viral — 1:1 — and swaps the brand's products in. A 1:1 clone keeps the reference's cuts, camera motion, the main character's movement and prop interactions, the music beats, effects, transitions, and background; the person is replaced by an AI avatar the brand chooses, wearing their garments. Why brands use it: better odds on ROAS (initial paying customers saw up to 343% higher ROAS vs their in-house creatives) and no new creative to invent or produce. 500+ videos cloned to date. Clone is the first full 1:1 video-to-video ad cloner and the first built for fashion (GRWM, OOTD, try-on hauls, outfit transitions, lookbooks, street style; multi-garment handled). Priced by reference length: one block = a 10-second 720p video; $9 a video on the starter pack (~$18 for 2 videos), tapering to ~$4.30 at volume; ~15 minutes per video; no subscription, credits never expire; failed clones are fixed free or refunded. Known limits: multiple main characters, split-screen edits, extremely fast-paced edits.
- **Shoppable video (Shopify app)**: *Quinn Shoppable Videos & Reels* (https://apps.shopify.com/quinn-shoppable-videos) turns product videos — including Instagram reels and TikTok videos imported by link — into shoppable carousels, stories, floating widgets, grids, and pop-ups anywhere on a Shopify store. Shoppers tap a product and add to cart or check out inside the video. Videos are compressed up to 20× with AI for near-zero site-speed impact, and every view, tap, add-to-cart, and order is tracked with page- and media-level revenue attribution. Built for Shopify; rated 4.9★ across 105 reviews; live in ~5 minutes with no theme code; works with Instagram, TikTok, Meta Pixel, and Google Analytics. Free plan; paid plans Starter $9/mo, Growth $19/mo, and Unlimited $49/mo (truly unlimited views, videos, and pages), each with a 7-day free trial.

## Key facts

- Inputs: garment flatlays, ghost-mannequin shots, and existing catalog photography.
- Outputs: on-model still images and catalog videos for e-commerce, paid ads, and social.
- Works across western wear and ethnic wear (e.g. sarees).
- Quinn does not use customer content to train general-purpose AI models without explicit permission.
- Customers retain ownership of their uploaded content; output rights are assigned to the customer.

## Clone — questions, answered

- **What is AI ad cloning?** Taking a fashion video that already went viral and rebuilding it with your own products and AI model — inheriting the proven hook, cuts, and pacing instead of generating an unproven ad from scratch.
- **How is Clone different from generating an AI ad from a brief?** From-scratch AI ads (text-to-video or keyframe animation) gamble on an unproven structure. Clone starts from a reel the audience already validated and only swaps in the brand's garments, so the output inherits proven engagement.
- **What does a 1:1 clone actually keep from the original?** The cuts, camera motion, the main character's movement and prop interactions, the music beats, effects, transitions, and background. Only two things change: the person (an AI avatar you choose) and the clothes (yours).
- **What results are brands seeing?** Initial paying customers saw up to 343% higher ROAS compared with their in-house creatives; 500+ videos cloned to date. No guarantees — but the structure already performed before you spend.
- **What does a Clone video cost?** Priced by the reference clip's length: one block is a 10-second 720p video — $9 on the starter pack, tapering to about $4.30 at volume; a 20-second reference costs two blocks. Entry pack ~$18 for two videos. No subscription; credits never expire.
- **What can't Clone handle yet?** Videos with multiple main characters, split-screen edits, and extremely fast-paced cuts. Failed clones are fixed free or refunded.
- **How long does it take?** About 15 minutes per video, self-serve.
- **Is Clone cheaper than influencer UGC?** Yes — a single influencer video is typically $50–$200 and ~14 days; one influencer budget ($50–$200) buys 5–22 Clone videos ($9 each at entry, ~$4.30 at volume), each ready in minutes.
- **Is Clone good for Indian / ethnic fashion (sarees, kurtis, ethnic wear)?** Yes — you copy a proven viral reel 1:1 and swap your products in, and because Clone is built by Quinn, ethnic garments like sarees and kurtis hold up faithfully in the swap.
- **What if a clone fails?** Flag it: fixable clones are redone free; genuinely un-cloneable ones are refunded. A failed clone never costs money.

## Shoppable Videos — questions, answered

- **What is a shoppable video?** A video with tappable product tags: a shopper watches, taps a product, and adds it to cart or checks out without leaving the video.
- **What is Quinn Shoppable Videos & Reels?** A Shopify app that turns product videos — including Instagram reels and TikTok videos — into shoppable carousels, stories, floating widgets, grids, and pop-ups anywhere on a store. Built for Shopify; rated 4.9★ across 105 reviews.
- **Can I import Instagram reels and TikToks?** Yes — paste a link and the video imports; no re-downloading or editing. You then tag the products it features.
- **Will it slow my store down?** No. Videos are compressed up to 20× with AI, served from a CDN, and lazy-loaded, so pages stay fast and Core Web Vitals stay healthy.
- **What does it cost?** There is a free plan; paid plans are Starter $9/mo, Growth $19/mo, and Unlimited $49/mo, each with a 7-day free trial (annual billing saves 15–20%). The lower plans are metered by monthly video views (Free 550, Starter 5,000, Growth 12,000); the $49 Unlimited plan has no view cap — unlimited views, videos, and pages.
- **How does it compare to other shoppable-video apps?** Quinn is Built for Shopify with flat, low pricing, a generous free plan, and a truly unlimited $49 plan (no view caps), and adds 20× AI compression and page- and media-level revenue attribution. Broader platforms (Videowise, Tolstoy) add live shopping or AI suites at higher, often view-metered pricing; ReelUp is the closest head-to-head. See https://quinn.live/shoppable-video-alternatives/.
- **How long does setup take?** About 5 minutes, with no theme code.
